literal_meaning: কেউ বা না কেউ (someone or no one)
figurative_meaning_bn: অনির্দিষ্ট কোন একজন, এ বা সে
figurative_meaning_en: Some unspecified person, this one or that one
example_sentences_in_bangla: কেউ না কেউ এই কাজটা করে দেবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Someone or other will do this job.
Somebody will be present at the party.
note: This idiom is a standard indefinite expression in colloquial Bengali, emphasizing vagueness in reference to persons.
